# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** head and front of the enterprise  <sub>[v2 c14 P5](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Rachel Lynde is an active woman who often sits at her kitchen window keeping a sharp eye on the main road. After her husband's long illness and death, her hands are described as work-hardened.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001)_

## Personality

Rachel Lynde is a capable, outspoken, and highly opinionated woman who prides herself on always speaking her mind. She is a busybody who keeps a sharp eye on everyone's business and dearly loves to give advice. Though she can be sharp, critical, and easily shocked by naughtiness, she is fundamentally a kind, good-hearted woman and a tender nurse. She is also a passionate, red-hot politician, a firm believer in predestination, and holds strong prejudices against outsiders.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c26 P25](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0025), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048), [v2 c20 P38](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0038), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c29 P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005)_

## History

Rachel Lynde lived for decades with her husband Thomas at Lynde's Hollow in Avonlea, managing her household and dominating local church societies while keeping close tabs on all neighborhood events. When Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert adopted Anne Shirley, Rachel visited Green Gables and insulted Anne's looks, prompting a fiery outburst from the girl; however, she readily accepted Anne's apology and eventually grew very fond of her. Being an ardent Liberal, she traveled to Charlottetown with Marilla and Thomas to attend a political mass meeting. At the local exhibition, she won first prize for her butter and cheese. Over time, her husband Thomas fell ill and eventually passed away quiet and unobtrusively, leaving Rachel grieving and facing financial difficulties because the farm had been mortgaged to help their youngest son in the West. Unable to keep the farm, she made arrangements to sell her extra household goods and accepted Marilla's invitation to move into Green Gables, setting up her quarters in the spare room.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v2 c10 P12](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0012), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000)_
